bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may take Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Passes For Human
bonuses.text: A DN 3 Awareness (Int) Test is required to notice a Neophyte Hybrid is not Human.

bonuses.name: Spiritual Leader
bonuses.text: Allied GENESTEALER CULT Threats within 10m of a Cult Magus gain +4 bonus dice to resist psychic powers.

abilities.name: Cult Recruitment
abilities.text: The Genestealer Cult Magus attempts to activate Possession (p.281).

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: The Cult Magus may attempt to activate any of the following psychic powers: Smite p.272, Psyniscience p.267, Deny the Witch p.267, Compel p.268, Fog the Mind p.279, Psychic Shriek p.279, Terrify p.280.

abilities.name: Broodmind
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Cult Magus attempts to activate a Psychic Power or Deny the Witch (p.267).
